reviews.comment: Terrible. Wow this class was not taught well at all. Dr. Jain showed us Zoom recordings of him teaching another class online last semester. We would log onto Zoom to watch a video of him teaching. What a joke. Shows absolutely ZERO examples in class, only shows how to derive the equations, not how to apply them. He is not willing to help students.

I did not like professor Jain too much. He's extremely passionate about fluid mechanics, but lectures simply are not too helpful. We go over zero examples in class-simply theory. Examples should be emphasized much more in class. Rework a ton of examples for exams and utilize the Teaching Assistant heavily.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy
